//==
// # Light source interface
//
// The marker interface for every scene light. The implementing types are
// declared in `lights.types.plato` and its derived bodies in `lights.library.plato`;
// the shadow-map, masking, and volumetric controls that accompany a light live
// in `lights.types.plato`.

// A scene light that can be toggled to cast shadows.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computer_graphics_lighting)
interface ILightSource

{
    CastsShadows(x: Self): Boolean;
}
